description: This source file defines the class EvictingConnectionLogger, which implements the ConnectionLogger interface. It manages logs related to connection events, maintaining a fixed capacity for success and failure logs with eviction policies. The class provides methods for logging success, failure, and exceptions, with options to include headers and payloads, and includes a builder for configuration.

classes.name: EvictingConnectionLogger
classes.description: Implementation of a connection logger with fixed capacity logs for successes and failures, with eviction policy and support for detailed message formatting.

classes.name: EvictingConnectionLogger.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for creating instances of EvictingConnectionLogger with custom configurations.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Logs a successful connection event with optional message and arguments.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Logs a failure event, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: exception
methods.description: Logs an exception event, with optional message.

methods.name: getLogs
methods.description: Retrieves all stored logs, both successes and failures.
